### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized). Standard Windows 11 chrome (Title bar + Taskbar).
*   **Sidebar (Left Pane):** [0, 60] to [280, 940]. Fixed width ~280px. Contains navigation items grouped by category.
    *   **Data Recovery Group:** [10, 95] to [270, 330].
    *   **Advanced Features Group:** [10, 370] to [270, 530].
    *   **File Backup Group:** [10, 565] to [270, 650].
*   **Main Content Area (Right Pane):** [290, 60] to [1014, 940]. White background with rounded corners (container).
    *   **Header Region:** [310, 95] to [990, 170]. Title and subtitle text.
    *   **Grid Region:** [310, 230] to [860, 850]. 2-column grid of feature cards.
        *   **Card Dimensions:** Approx 265px wide x 180px tall.
        *   **Grid Gap:** ~20px horizontal, ~20px vertical.
*   **Taskbar (Bottom):** [0, 940] to [1024, 768]. Standard Windows 11 centered layout.

### 2) TEXT
*   **Window Title:** "EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free" [45, 25]
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** "Data Recovery" [18, 105]
*   **Sidebar - Item:** "Hardware Disk" [68, 160]
*   **Sidebar - Item:** "SD Card" [68, 230]
*   **Sidebar - Item (Selected):** "More Recovery Tools" [68, 300]
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** "Advanced Features" [18, 380]
*   **Sidebar - Item:** "File Repair" [68, 430]
*   **Sidebar - Item:** "Lost Partition Rescue" [68, 500]
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** "File Backup" [18, 570]
*   **Sidebar - Item:** "ChronoSnap Backup" [68, 620]
*   **Main - Title:** "More Recovery Tools" [310, 110]
*   **Main - Subtitle:** "Tackle complex data loss with our advanced recovery tools." [310, 155]
*   **Card 1 - Title:** "Crashed PC Rescue" [325, 330]
*   **Card 1 - Desc:** "Rescue data from an unbootable computer for any reason." [325, 370]
*   **Card 2 - Title:** "NAS and Linux" [600, 330]
*   **Card 2 - Desc:** "Easily recover your NAS and Linux data." [600, 370]
*   **Card 3 - Title:** "RAID Recovery" [325, 560]
*   **Card 3 - Desc:** "Automatically detect and recover RAID data." [325, 600]
*   **Card 4 - Title:** "Cloud Recovery" [600, 560]
*   **Card 4 - Desc:** "Recover your lost or deleted data from Cloud drives." [600, 600]
*   **Card 5 - Title:** "Image Recovery" [325, 770]
*   **Card 5 - Desc:** "Create and restore full images of physical drives and virtual machines." [325, 810]
*   **Card 6 - Title:** "Disk Health" [600, 770]
*   **Card 6 - Desc:** "Check disk before recovery." [600, 810]

### 3) COLOR
*   **Background (App/Window):** `#F5F8FC` (Light Blue-Grey)
*   **Surface (Main Content):** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Surface (Sidebar Item Selected):** `#E6F0FF` (Light Blue)
*   **Text (Primary/Headings):** `#1F1F1F` (Near Black)
*   **Text (Secondary/Descriptions):** `#5C5C5C` (Dark Grey)
*   **Text (Sidebar Headers):** `#8C8C8C` (Medium Grey)
*   **Text (Selected Sidebar Item):** `#1677FF` (Bright Blue)
*   **Accent (Icons/Links):** `#1677FF` (Blue)
*   **Border (Cards):** `#E8E8E8` (Light Grey)
*   **Icon Background (Card Top-Left):** `#F0F2F5` (Very Light Grey)

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Main Title:** Sans-Serif (Segoe UI/Inter), ~24px, Weight 600 (Semi-Bold).
*   **Card Titles:** Sans-Serif, ~16px, Weight 600 (Semi-Bold).
*   **Body Text / Descriptions:** Sans-Serif, ~13px, Weight 400 (Regular), Line height ~1.5.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Sans-Serif, ~14px, Weight 500 (Medium).
*   **Sidebar Section Headers:** Sans-Serif, ~12px, Weight 400 (Regular).

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** 280px.
*   **Content Padding (Left/Top):** ~30px.
*   **Card Padding:** ~24px.
*   **Card Border Radius:** 8px.
*   **Card Icon Container:** 48x48px, Border Radius 8px.
*   **Sidebar Item Height:** ~44px.
*   **Sidebar Selection Indicator:** Left border 3px solid blue (implicit or background highlight).
*   **Grid Column Gap:** 20px.
*   **Grid Row Gap:** 20px.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List:**
    *   **Hardware Disk:** Normal state. Has a green checkmark badge (success/state indicator).
    *   **SD Card:** Normal state.
    *   **More Recovery Tools:** **Selected State**. Light blue background, blue text.
    *   **File Repair:** Normal state.
    *   **Lost Partition Rescue:** Normal state.
    *   **ChronoSnap Backup:** Normal state.
*   **Feature Cards:**
    *   All 6 cards appear in **Normal/Hoverable** state. No visible "pressed" or "disabled" states.
    *   They function as clickable tiles/buttons.
*   **Window Controls (Top Right):**
    *   Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close buttons. Standard Windows 11 style.
*   **Header Icons (Top Right):**
    *   Cloud icon (User/Account).
    *   Shopping Cart (Upgrade).
    *   Gift Box (Promo/Offers).
    *   Info/Help (?).
    *   Hamburger Menu (List view toggle?).
    *   All appear as icon buttons in normal state.

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (mostly filled shapes with outline details), rounded corners.
*   **Grid:** 24x24px or 32x32px base grid for sidebar icons. 24x24px for card icons (inside 48px container).
*   **Weights:** Stroke width approx 1.5px - 2px.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   **Sidebar Icons:** Hardware Disk (HDD), SD Card, Tools/Wrench (selected), Folder/Magic (Repair), Lifebuoy (Rescue), Clock/History (Backup).
    *   **Card Icons:** PC/Screen (Crashed PC), Server Stack (NAS), Server Rack (RAID), Cloud (Cloud), Image/File (Image), Heartbeat/ECG (Health). Note: Most card icons have a small circular badge overlay (e.g., 'i', refresh arrow, lock, heartbeat line).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Success / Idle / Ready**. The page has fully loaded content. It is not loading, empty, or in an error state.
*   **Context:** The user is currently viewing the "More Recovery Tools" section of the application. The "Hardware Disk" section appears to have been completed or is active (indicated by the green checkmark).
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot).
